requirement: EmDash quickstart site: /app is www-data's, so rebuild, pnpm install/add and a restart work as the site user

oracle.ref: PR #1681 (fix); fix evidence: Owner investigation 24/10/2026 on dev (site emdashown1024): 1,589 uid-501 + 832 root files under /app from the tools layer; astro build EACCES; pnpm add ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE; a failed reinstall emptied node_modules.
oracle.invariant: S2: a quickstart archive is unpacked without its owners, built, then everything under /app is handed back to the site user S2: pnpm-workspace.yaml and node_modules/.modules.yaml name the same store inside /app, idempotently; another EmDash version still gets the store pin and the owners S2: the site user gets a home and the project's pnpm is fetched as that user in /app; a failed fetch only warns S2: a non-quickstart image gets no store rewrite, no chown, no home and no Corepack run; a bad archive checksum fails the layer S3: /app/tracy-mint.cjs is removed after a clean mint and after a failed one (the failure still fails) S3: foreign owners under /app are warned about (digest excluded) without failing the site; a clean /app prints nothing
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
